MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable felt relevant because I have bought a display cable before, so connecting a display is a plausible need for me.",
    "A cable is a practical accessory like my USB and Ethernet adapters, though I would only choose it after checking my ports and whether I need another cable."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming devices, smart speakers and smart displays do not address the computer connection and mounting needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "Having bought a headset does not mean I currently want wireless earbuds or need to replace my existing audio equipment.",
    "The external drive connects through USB, but that connection alone does not give me a reason to need 16TB of storage."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in specific electronics accessories seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any electronic device.",
    "The repeated Alexa products suggest an interest in a connected home that my purchases do not establish."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases point toward specific practical tasks: adding ports, connecting to a network, connecting a display or mounting a tablet.",
    "Compatibility matters: a useful accessory needs to fit my actual ports and equipment, rather than simply share a term like USB.",
    "My purchases are spaced far apart, and I would usually wait for a concrete need before choosing another device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The cable partly fits my practical accessory needs, but most suggestions assume broader interests in streaming and smart home devices that my history does not support."
}
